name: ai-utilities
description: Utility skills for building and vetting Claude Code extensions (skill-creator, skill-review) and for closing the plan-to-implementation loop (plan-completion-audit, audit-resolver).

interface.shortDescription: Author, review, and audit Claude Code extensions and plans
interface.longDescription: A utility toolkit of four skills and one command. skill-creator scaffolds, rebuilds, validates, and packages Claude Code skills or plugins. skill-review runs a security, safety, and quality review of a marketplace, plugin, or skill before install. plan-completion-audit audits a project plan against the actual implementation. audit-resolver reads that audit and applies the fixes with per-finding safety gates. The audit-resolve command chains plan-completion-audit into audit-resolver.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a new Claude Code skill for this purpose.
Review this plugin or marketplace for security and quality before I install it.
Audit this plan against the implementation, then resolve the findings.
